description: Election Commission - Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha - 2024 Filling at a Vacancy in the Office of Chairman Under Section 66B (2)
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in the office of Chairman of the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha, which is an electoral process matter under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of an elected official to fill a position that became vacant due to resignation, following procedures outlined in election laws. This falls squarely under Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for local authorities.
